claims.statement: Installation grants requested organization/repository permissions and selected repository access; user authorization grants requested account permissions and acting-on-behalf authority. They can occur independently, so neither proves the other. Metadata/issues and email/gist examples illustrate separate scopes, not permissions to adopt; screenshot captions are not visual asset certification.

Readback of installation, user authorization and actual effective API access must be separate evidence; source UI descriptions do not establish current grants. The linked permission guide requires its own review.

For fpt/ghec, account registration is capped at 100 Apps for users/organizations, with enterprises included only under enterprise-apps-public-beta. Installed-App count is stated unlimited. Registration limits and installation counts are different denominators and neither authorizes unlimited grants.
